[[Phoenix's Retribution]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[staff]] dropped by [[Imperial Guard Lockbox]]es.

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +10
:[[Lightning damage|Lightning Dmg]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Channeling Magic]])
:[[HSR|Halves skill recharge]] of [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:Energy +5 (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:Channeling Magic +1 (20% chance while using skills)
:Health +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Illusory Staff]].

==Replica==
Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create an exact technical replica for this item with:
*One of the following [[Channeling Magic]] [[staves]]:
**[[Destroyer Staff]] from crafter [[Balthor Coalforge]]
**[[Tormented Staff]] from collector [[Deacon of Whispers]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Hale]] [[Staff Head]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Staff Wrapping]] [[of Mastery]] OR [[of Attribute|of Channeling Magic]]
OR
*One of the following [[Channeling Magic]] [[staves]]:
**[[Channeling Staff]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Bolereh]], [[Derrick]], [[Rahmdah]], [[Sende]], or [[Soros]]
**[[Asuran Staff]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
**[[Balthazar's Staff]] from collector [[Zaishen Spirit Weapon Master]]
